posts.story: Hotel restaurant GST: a room sold above Rs 7,500 last year makes the hotel's restaurant bills 18% with input credit instead of 5% without; Rizstay stay code and live orders
lines: Hotel owners, your restaurant might be charging the wrong GST.
Rule 1. Sold any room above ₹7,500 a night last financial year?
Then your restaurant bills this year carry 18% GST. Not 5.
A ₹2,000 dinner? That's ₹360 of GST, not ₹100. Send this to whoever does your billing.
Rule 2. Every room at ₹7,500 or less? Food stays at 5%, but you can't claim input credit.
Rule 3. On the 18% side, you claim back the GST you paid on supplies.
In Rizstay, new, preparing and ready orders update live on every screen.
Room guests type a private stay code. They see their stay, amenities and running bill.
Comment RATE. I'll send you the 1 page check. Follow so my DM reaches you.

posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel (English): the hotel across the street is full because it posts every day; Priya says they posted once in March; Kaka says let someone write, make and post it for you while you just approve on your phone (Velocity); replies and guest messages come to the phone; Bablu fully booked
posts.hook: Our food is better. So why are we *empty*?
lines: Our food is better. So why is that hotel full... and we are empty?
Sir, they post on Instagram every single day. We posted once... in March.
Then let someone do it for you, beta. They write your posts,
make the videos, and post on time. You just say yes, on your phone.
And it replies to comments, and every guest message comes straight to our phone. Nothing goes out without your okay, sir.
Fully booked this weekend... and I did not write a single post!

posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel (Hindi) EP5: five kilo paneer bought yesterday is gone today; Ramu the cook admits half spoiled and he threw it without writing it down; Kaka says keep Rizstay's waste log (what, how much, who logged it); Priya says enter purchases and stock refills itself, and reports filter by date and export to Excel; Bablu tracks every gram on his phone
lines: Kal paanch kilo paneer aaya tha... aaj phir khatam? Paneer gaya kahaan?!
Saab, aadha paneer kharab ho gaya tha... maine phenk diya. Kahin likha nahi.
Beta, Rizstay ka waste log rakho. Kya phenka,
kitna phenka, aur kisne likha... sab dikhega.
Sir, naya paneer kharido toh purchase mein daalo,
stock apne aap bhar jaata hai.
Aur report date se filter karke Excel mein nikaal lo.
Ab har gram paneer ka hisaab mere phone pe! Agla episode kal...

posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel (English) EP6: the new chef joins Monday and his papers are lost in a pile at the front desk; Sunil the new chef asks if anyone got the ID and certificates he sent; Kaka says HR4U shows every new joiner's stage (pending documents, background check, cleared, active) and a failed check keeps its reason; Priya says the appointment letter is already in his inbox and he tapped acknowledge; Bablu has the chef cleared and active on HR4U
posts.hook: New chef Monday. His papers? *Somewhere in here.*
lines: Our new chef joins on Monday... and his papers are somewhere in this pile!
Sir, I sent my ID and my certificates last week. Did anyone get them?
Beta, HR4U shows every new joiner:
pending documents, background check, cleared, active.
And if a check fails,
the reason is written right there. No guessing, beta.
Sir, his appointment letter is already in his inbox.
He tapped acknowledge.
Papers checked, chef cleared and active... all on HR4U! Follow for the next episode!

posts.story: Bablu's Hotel (English) EP8: thirty enquiry calls in a week and only two bookings; Priya says half the callers ask the same three questions; Kaka says teach the AI phone agent those answers once so it picks up every call and you only talk to real buyers; Priya lists the setup (describe the hotel, add FAQs, connect the number) and it went live the same afternoon; the agent asks each caller what they need and books the serious one; Bablu now only talks to guests ready to book
lines: Thirty enquiry calls this week... and only two bookings? Where did the rest go?
and half of them asked the same three questions!

and you talk only to real buyers.

and booked the serious one straight into our calendar!
Every enquiry call answered... and I only talk to guests ready to book!

Training bhi, promotion bhi, nayi tankhwah ka poora hisaab bhi...
sab ek jagah!

posts.hook: They booked the hotel *across the street.*

Sir, they have a website with a WhatsApp button. We only have a visiting card.

your phone number, a WhatsApp button and a contact form.

posts.story: Bablu's Hotel (English) EP12: at 7 AM Bablu finds Ramu forgot to clock out last night and asks if he must pay sixteen hours; Ramu admits he went home without tapping out; Kaka says in HR4U an idle session closes on its own; Ramu works a morning and an evening shift and clocks in for both, each with its own live timer; Priya shows Ramu's correction request waiting for Bablu's decision; Bablu approves it from his phone and Ramu is paid for the real hours
lines: Ramu forgot to clock out last night. Do I pay him for sixteen hours?
Sorry sir, I went home and forgot to tap out!
Son, in HR4U an idle session closes on its own.

Morning shift, evening shift...
